test_title: SSC CPO Tier-II Previous Year Paper (Held On: 26th July 2021)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom in the given sentence.

India’s problem __boils down__ to just one thing – lack of infrastructure for health services.
solution:
The correct answer is Sums up to.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• The idiom boils down means *reduce the volume of a liquid by boiling. Or **"*****to be the main reason for something or the most basic part of something*"***

 
 
• Ex: "they boil down the syrup until it is very thick".
 
 
 
• ​The phrase 'sums up to' is the closest phrase to the idiom 'boils down'.
 
• Therefore, by reading the above explanation we find that the correct answer is Option 2.
